title: The Beginning of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji gazed upon that primordial inscription, an ancient and majestic consciousness surged into his Mental Sea—the Heavenly Eye had spoken to him for the first time.

text.content: The Void Chessboard resembled a shattered star domain floating in chaos. The instant Chen Ji stepped onto it, his form was enveloped by countless silver-white threads. These threads were no ordinary things—they were threads of destiny condensed from Heavenly Dao laws—each one connecting to a person's past and future. "Welcome to the starting point of ten thousand years ago." Cang Yuan's voice came from all directions, "Since you've come this far, I shall show you how the Tianji Record was born."

Before the words even faded, the surrounding void twisted violently. A dazzling, brilliant light rose from beneath Chen Ji's feet, swallowing him whole. When he opened his eyes again, the scene before him had completely changed—it was a vast, boundless ancient battlefield, the heavens shattered, the earth submerged, countless cultivators' bones piled into mountains. The stench of blood in the air was so thick it was almost nauseating. This was the great cataclysm from ten thousand years ago that had destroyed everything.

"This is... the day the Heavenly Dao collapsed." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice trembling slightly from shock. He recognized this battlefield—the Tianji Record Fragment had once recorded this great cataclysm, but no one had ever witnessed its horrific devastation firsthand. And now, he stood at the source of history, watching with his own eyes how the power that destroyed everything tore this world apart.

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" Cang Yuan's remnant soul appeared beside Chen Ji, his voice low. "During that great cataclysm, more than half of the world's seers perished. The Heavenly Dao collapsed, the laws descended into chaos, countless geniuses fell. And from the ruins, seven individuals... stood forth."

text.content: Chen Ji followed Cang Yuan's gesture and looked over, seeing seven figures standing in the center of the battlefield. The seven were surrounded by differently colored lights, representing seven completely distinct Daos. He could vaguely identify six of them—those were the six Chess Players mentioned in later Tianji Record records. But when his gaze fell upon the seventh figure, his heart suddenly contracted. That figure... was blurred almost beyond recognition, yet emanated a breath of familiarity that struck him inexplicably.

dialogue.content: "Who is this seventh person?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice, his tone carrying restrained urgency. He had studied the Tianji Record for many years and knew the identities of the six Chess Players by heart, yet he had never encountered any record mentioning the existence of a seventh person.

text.content: Cang Yuan fell silent for a moment, his fragmented soul trembling slightly, as if recalling something extraordinarily ancient. After a long while, he spoke: "There is no record of him in the Tianji Record. Because... his existence itself was deliberately erased." His voice grew ethereal. "But you must remember—of these seven, his position was the most special. Without him, there would be no Tianji Record afterward."

Just then, the battlefield scene shifted again. Chen Ji watched as those seven began communicating with the Heavenly Dao in some profound, mysterious way, attempting to weave the shattered laws back together. One of them produced a scroll radiating golden light—that was the prototype of the Tianji Record. But just as they were about to succeed, that blurred seventh figure suddenly turned around, facing a certain point in the void, and let out a soundless laugh.

"So that's how it was... so everything had been calculated long ago." Chen Ji's body went cold, his voice hoarse and barely recognizable as his own. That seventh person's smile was full of mockery and scheming, as if everything from the very beginning had been under his control. And he, Chen Ji—the so-called seventh-generation Chess Player chosen by the Tianji Record... perhaps had been written into this chess game since ten thousand years ago.

The scene switched once more. This time, Chen Ji saw the moment the Tianji Record was sealed—that fifth page was not torn; it was covered by a layer of pitch-black restriction. The one who sealed it was precisely one of the six Chess Players. His features were equally blurred, but in the instant he sealed the fifth page, Chen Ji clearly saw him raise his head, face a certain direction in the void, and utter a soundless sentence.

dialogue.content: "It said: 'Rest assured, this page will never be seen by anyone.'" Cang Yuan's voice suddenly turned eerie. "And at this moment, that sealed thing... is calling to you."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, only to find the Tianji Record had somehow appeared in his hands, the black mist on the fifth page slowly dissipating, revealing a corner of the primordial inscription buried deep within. That inscription radiated an energy completely opposite to his Heavenly Fate Value in his body—it was the power of the Heavenly Dao, yet also not. Cang Yuan was right; that sealed thing... was waiting for him.

choice.prompt: Faced with this deliberately erased truth and the starting point of destiny, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Since destiny was long ago fated, I shall follow the flow and see where this chess game ultimately leads me.
choices.visible_cost: Continue being carried by destiny without questioning
choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial unsealing of the Tianji Record's fifth page
choices.risk_hint: May forever be trapped in the chess game set by others

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, allowing that Heavenly power to flood into his body. Since the performance must go on, he would play it to the end. He wanted to see exactly what this script of destiny had written. And the instant he "submitted," the black mist on the fifth page dissipated even faster—as if something was delighted that he had made the "right" choice.

choices.description: A layout from ten thousand years ago cannot be flawless; every chess game has loopholes. I shall question the one behind the scenes.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing my suspicions may invite deeper schemes
choices.visible_reward: May force the other party to reveal weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's existence may be far more terrifying than imagined

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his voice cold: "Since this seventh person's existence was deliberately erased, let me ask— who erased it? The six Chess Players, or... an even higher power?" His gaze stabbed directly at a certain point in the void. "Heavenly Eye, I know you're watching."

choices.description: Any written destiny has loopholes; I shall search for a way to break the game within that primordial inscription.
choices.visible_cost: Forcibly probing the seal may cause backlash
choices.visible_reward: May discover the key to reversing destiny
choices.risk_hint: The power behind the seal is unknowable; recklessly touching it could lead to eternal damnation

text.content: Chen Ji paid no heed to Cang Yuan's suggestion; instead, he poured all his focus into the Tianji Record's fifth page. The primordial inscription's energy strangely resonated with his Heavenly Fate Value—he suddenly realized something: the restriction sealing this page was using his own Heavenly Fate power. In other words, this seal... was tailor-made for him. And things tailor-made typically imply one of two things: either a trap, or... an opportunity.

A majestic pressure suddenly flooded Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was a presence that transcended his understanding, as if the entire heavens and earth were gazing down upon him. Cang Yuan's remnant soul trembled violently at this moment, almost dispersing. "It... has come." Cang Yuan's voice was full of fear. "The Heavenly Eye has never gazed upon a person so clearly..."

Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly at the colossal eye slowly opening in the depths of the void. That pupil contained no emotion whatsoever—only absolute order and cold indifference. While it gazed upon him, it was also evaluating him—assessing the value of a chess piece. And at this moment, Chen Ji finally understood: he was never any chosen genius; he was merely... a needed tool. So it was ten thousand years ago, and so it remains ten thousand years later.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye is examining you. This time, how do you choose to respond?

choices.description: Express obedience to the Heavenly Eye, trading it for a chance to breathe and secretly gather strength.
choices.visible_cost: Lose part of your independent consciousness
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily remove obstacles to unsealing the fifth page
choices.risk_hint: Submission may turn you into a true puppet

text.content: Chen Ji slowly knelt on one knee, signaling submission. The Heavenly Eye seemed quite satisfied with his choice, the pressure easing considerably. But beneath that submissive posture, a faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips—he thought of Chen Nian, of those still waiting for him. If the other party wanted a chess piece, he would give them a obedient chess piece. As for when this piece would turn against its master... that would depend on who had more patience.

choices.description: Even if you are the will of the Heavenly Dao, I shall defy heaven and change my fate. I ask if you dare to wager with me.
choices.visible_cost: May incur the Heavenly Dao's direct erasure
choices.visible_reward: If successful, may break the ten-thousand-year layout
choices.risk_hint: Victory is extremely unlikely, but if I do not try, I shall never have a chance to turn the tide

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly straightened, his eyes blazing with unprecedented sharpness. He stepped forward, facing the Heavenly Eye, and said coldly: "Ten thousand years ago you set this chess game, making me a chess piece. Now let me ask—if this piece refuses to be a piece and wants to overturn the entire board, what would you do?" The words fell, and the Tianji Record's fifth page suddenly blazed, forming a confrontation with the Heavenly Eye.

At this moment of extreme tension, the Heavenly Eye did not, as Chen Ji had expected, unleash destructive annihilation. It merely gazed at him silently, and deep within that colossal pupil, a trace of... amusement actually flickered. The next moment, a voice directly rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, ancient and majestic, as if heaven and earth itself were speaking: "Interesting. You are the first ant to dare question this one."

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unmoved. He stared directly at that colossal Heavenly eye, his mind racing rapidly. Since the other party was willing to speak, there was room for negotiation. "Ant?" He sneered, "If I were truly an ant, why would you have watched me for ten thousand years? Speak—what exactly do you want me to do?"

dialogue.content: "Do?" That ancient voice carried a hint of mockery. "You think you are resisting, not knowing that every act of your resistance pushes the wheel of destiny forward. I need nothing from you... I only need you to continue walking. Walk to that... destination you must reach."

text.content: The voice cut off abruptly, and the Heavenly Eye slowly closed as well. But just before it completely vanished, Chen Ji clearly saw its final message—the seal on the fifth page was dissipating at a slow yet irreversible pace. No matter what choices he made, that seal was destined to open. And he was destined to see the truth hidden for ten thousand years.

choice.prompt: The seal is dissipating. At this final moment—how will you face the primordial inscription about to appear?

choices.description: Since it cannot be stopped, let things take their natural course and assess the full picture of the inscription before making plans.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He sat cross-legged, allowing the seal to disintegrate inch by inch. Whatever that inscription contained, he would see it with his own eyes. This was his resolve as a chess piece, and also his obsession as a chess master.

choices.description: Not waiting for the seal to dissipate, proactively touch that primordial inscription with Heavenly Fate power to accelerate unsealing.
choices.visible_cost: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate, possible immediate unconsciousness
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative and see key information before the other party can react
choices.risk_hint: May be struck by residual forces within the inscription

text.content: Chen Ji thrust out his hand abruptly, his five fingers deeply embedding into the fifth page. Heavenly Fate power surged out like a breached flood, forcibly tearing through the remaining seal. Agonizing pain assaulted him; his Mental Sea felt as if it were being torn apart. However, just as consciousness was about to scatter, he saw the inscription's contents—a prophecy before it was tampered with, and the protagonist of that prophecy was赫然是... Chen Nian.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. That name, that blurred figure, the sister he had searched for all these years...竟然与天机录的创制有着如此深刻的关联。原始刻印中清晰地记载着："天命锁钥，承载天道最后一线生机。万年后，将由陈氏血脉开启新的纪元。"陈念，她从来不是什么被圣宗掳走的受害者——她是这一切的……核心。
剧烈的shocked令陈机的身形slightly摇晃。他万万没想到，自己费尽心机想要保护的人，从一开始就是这棋局中不可或缺的一环。更令他心寒的是，他这些年所有的筹谋、布局、endured……或许都在某些更高存在的预料之中。可即便如此，那又如何？既然已经看到了真相，他便有了改变的可能。而那，便是陈机面对命运时最后的stubborn。
